name: o73913

schema.title: JSON schema for Bower configuration files

description.description: Help users identify and search for your package with a brief description.

main.description: The primary acting files necessary to use your package.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or path/url to a license.

ignore.description: A list of files for Bower to ignore when installing your package.

keywords.description: Used for search by keyword. Helps make your package easier to discover without people needing to know its name.

authors.description: A list of people that authored the contents of the package.

homepage.description: URL to learn more about the package. Falls back to GitHub project if not specified and it's a GitHub endpoint.

repository.description: The repository in which the source code can be found.

dependencies.description: Dependencies are specified with a simple hash of package name to a semver compatible identifier or URL.

devDependencies.description: Dependencies that are only needed for development of the package, e.g., test framework or building documentation.

resolutions.description: Dependency versions to automatically resolve with if conflicts occur between packages.

private.description: If you set it to  true  it will refuse to publish it. This is a way to prevent accidental publication of private repositories.

exportsOverride.description: Used by grunt-bower-task to specify custom install locations.

moduleType.description: The types of modules this package exposes

^_.description: Any property starting with _ is valid.

valid_json.name: awesome-widget
valid_json.description: A lightweight widget for building responsive dashboards.

description:
The **awesome‑widget** package (v 1.3.0) is a lightweight widget designed for building responsive dashboards. Its primary assets are the uncompressed script `dist/awesome-widget.js` and the minified version `dist/awesome-widget.min.js`; both are listed as the main entry points. Distributed under the MIT license, the component is tagged with the keywords *widget*, *dashboard*, *responsive*, *ui*, and *awesome* to aid discovery. The project is authored by Jane Doe <jane@example.com> and John Smith (john@example.com, https://johnsmith.dev). More information can be found on the homepage https://github.com/awesome/widget, and the source lives in a Git repository (type git) at git+https://github.com/awesome/widget.git.

When installing, Bower will ignore hidden files (`**/.*`), the `test/` directory, and any documentation under `docs/`. Runtime dependencies are `jquery` (compatible with ^3.5.1) and `lodash` (≈ 4.17.20), while development relies on `mocha` (^8.2.1) and `chai` (^4.2.0). To resolve version conflicts, the package forces `jquery` to version 3.5.1. The package is public (`private: false`) and uses an exports override that maps the distribution folder’s JavaScript to `dist/awesome-widget.min.js` and its CSS to `dist/awesome-widget.css`. It declares support for AMD and global module types. Internally, the metadata records the maintainer as **Team Awesome** and notes that the repository type is **public**.
